title: Young Added Drivers and the Endorsement Deposit — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Rule.** When an endorsement deposit is taken on an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan of the **Installment Payment Plans**, a percentage of the endorsement balance is added to the deposit according to the age of the most recent driver added to the owner term, on that addition's change effective date:

| Age of the most recent driver added, on the change effective date | Added to the endorsement deposit |
|---|---|
| under 21 (fewer than 252 whole calendar months since the date of birth) | 10 percent of the endorsement balance |
| 21 or older but under 25 (at least 252 and fewer than 300 whole months) | 5 percent of the endorsement balance |
| 25 or older (300 whole months or more), or no driver added | nothing |

**Counting age.** Age is counted in whole calendar months from the driver's date of birth to the change effective date. A whole calendar month is complete only when the later date's day number is at least the earlier date's day number, so a month that starts on a day the later month lacks is not complete until the next month.

**Most recent driver added.** It is the driver addition with the latest change effective date on the Owner Auto Policy term; of two added on the same date, the one recorded first. The driver's date of birth and the change effective date are read from the Owner Auto Policy term's driver change records.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical dates).** A driver born on 15 June 2010 and added with a change effective date of 14 June 2031 has 251 whole months and is under 21; added on 15 June 2031, 252 whole months, 21 or older. For a month that starts on the 31st of January, 28 February does not complete it, since February has no 31st; the month is complete on 1 March.
